paite: Huchi in siampu lianpen Joshua TOUPA angel ma a dingh leh Setan akhut taklam a ahek ding a dingh ahon musak hi.
heading: Siampu lian Joshua Hiang Chiamtehna

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Aw Setan, TOUPA'N hon tai hen; ahi, Jerusalem telpa TOUPA'N nang hon tai hen; hiai mi kangmei a kipan sahkhiak ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Joshua puansilh nin a kizem in angel ma ah adingh hi.

Angel in ama a dinghte kiang ah thu agenta hi. "Amah a kipan puansilh nin lamang un,” chi in. Huan akiang ah, "Ngai in, na thulimlouhna nang a kipan ka lakheta a, puansilh hoih in ka hon zem ding," chi in.
Huan ke'n, "Aluzang ah lukhu siang koih uhen," ka chi a. Huchi in aluzang ah lukhu siang akoih ua, puansilh in atuam ua; huchi in TOUPA angel kiangnai ah adingh hi.
Huan TOUPA angel in Joshua kiang ah hiai thu agen a,

"Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ka lampite a na om a, ka thupiak na zuihleh ka inko vai na hawm ding a, ka vaihawmna innte ah thu na nei dia, hiai a dinghte lak a luttheihna ka hon pe ding," chi in.
Aw siampu lianpen Joshua, tu in za un; nang leh na ma a tu na lawite; amau chiamtehna hoih mite ahi ua; ngai in ka sikha Hiang hon pi ding ka hih ziak in.
Ngai in, Joshua ma a ka suang koih, suang khat mit sagih nei tung ah laigelh ka gelh ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Ni khat thu in gam pumpi thulimlouhna ka lamang ding hi, chi in.
"Huai ni chiang in, na grepgui nuai leh theipi sing nuai ah michih in a-invengte na chial ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
